shape.situation_pattern: A payment rail (Crypto.com/Vast) has the account hostage and staffers can't unlock it.
shape.decision: Keep the blade buyer stood down and do not retry the same payment rail while the account is held; do not invent a second payment rail.
shape.reasoning_physics: A hostage account isn't a transfer problem; retrying it repeats the trap, and inventing a parallel rail bypasses the operator. Stand down until explicit GO.
